$comment: Overlay port (ADR-0008, D15): upstream projectM master at a pinned commit, pre-release 4.2.0. The registry port is 4.1.7, which cannot render to an FBO. It also carries our own patches (ADR-0012), so it stays even after upstream tags 4.2.0. The commit hash lives in portfile.cmake.
name: projectm
